title: sdk-docs-todo-jordan-park
content:
Daily scratchpad: SDK docs + sample app fixes (personal notes)

Context:
- Quick notes from today while triaging SDK docs issues reported by early adopters. Focus: Node + Python quickstarts, streaming examples, and function-calling sample app.
- Goal: ship a small patch release to docs and one sample app update before next week’s release train.

High-level problems observed:
1) Node quickstart omits explicit env var example for STREAMING=true vs stream:false. Users get confusing partial streaming responses.
2) Python SDK streaming callback examples use old callback signature (on_chunk) — mismatch with new SDK (on_token). Need to reconcile and add migration note.
3) Function calling tutorial (sample app: shopping-assistant) demo uses deprecated schema for arguments; unit tests fail on new runtime.
4) Sample app README missing instruction to run with docker-compose.override for private deployments; users on Private hit networking issues.
5) Few reference links to Redwood Console rollout docs are stale (pointing to internal Confluence pages). Replace with canonical public docs or add migration note.

Notes-to-self (brain dump):
- Prioritize items that block customers (streaming docs and function-calls).
- Small doc fixes can be shipped as a patch (docs-only release). Sample app code changes require PR + quick test matrix.
- Coordinate with Alex for a quick PR to python-sdk repo and with Priya on sample app tests.

Unresolved questions:
- For streaming, should we show both boolean flag (stream: true) and env var examples, or pick one canonical approach? (Prefer showing both with recommended canonical: explicit option in client call.)
- Function-calling schema: do we update tutorial to new schema or include a compatibility wrapper helper in sample app? (Wrapper seems lower friction.)
- Private deployment note: who owns docker-compose images for sample apps? tag@infra or solutions-eng? Need owner to verify image and network vars.

Todo (short actionable list):
- [ ] Update Node quickstart code block to show streaming example and mention SERVER_SIDE_STREAMING env var. (owner: Jordan)
- [ ] Fix Python SDK streaming example to use on_token signature and add migration note. (owner: Alex Wu)
- [ ] Patch function-calling tutorial: update schema and add compatibility helper in sample app. (owner: Priya Sharma)
- [ ] Add docker-compose.override example to shopping-assistant README and doc note for Private. (owner: Mikaela Chen)
- [ ] Replace stale console links in docs; add redirect note if needed. (owner: Jordan)
- [ ] Add unit test in sample-apps CI to run function-calling flow against latest runtime image. (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Draft changelog entry for docs patch release (owner: Jordan)

Quick implementation plan:
- Today: create 3 PR branches: docs/node-streaming-fix, sdk/python-stream-migration, apps/shopping-func-schema. Add minimal tests for each.
- Tomorrow: sync with Priya + Alex in 30m standup to unblock PR reviews.
- Friday: aim to merge docs-only PR and cut patch release; coordinate sample app merge for next week.

Snippet to paste into PR description (copy-edit later):
- Summary: Fix streaming examples across Node and Python SDK quickstarts; update function-calling tutorial and shopping-assistant sample app to be compatible with latest runtime schema. Add docker-compose.override example for Private deployments.
- Impact: developer experience improvements; unblocks customers testing streaming and function-calls; no breaking API changes.

Links/references (todo to replace with real URLs):
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1234 (internal notes on streaming behavior)
- GitHub: GH-PR-8421 (previous attempt at streaming docs fix)
- Jira: JIRA-DX-58 (customer reported issue: streaming missing example)

Quick copy snippets to use in edits:
- Node streaming example (short):
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'rw-text-1', prompt: 'Write a haiku', stream: true });
res.on('data', (chunk) => { console.log(chunk.text); });

- Python on_token migration example:
# old (on_chunk)
# def on_chunk(chunk):
#    print(chunk['text'])

# new (on_token)
def on_token(token):
    print(token.text)

Notes: need to verify method name and example types with SDK team (Alex).

Daily log:
- 09:10 — triaged customer issues, reproduced streaming behavior locally
- 10:00 — made quick edit to Node doc draft, pushed branch docs/node-streaming-fix
- 11:30 — pinged Alex about python callback change (awaiting reply)
- 13:00 — investigated sample app failing tests, traced to schema mismatch
- 15:00 — added failing unit test for apps/shopping (local) and created issue in GH repo
- 16:30 — quick sync with Priya re: sample app patch plan
- 17:15 — wrote this scratchpad + TODOs

Misc (notes to self):
- Keep PRs small and docs-focused to expedite reviews.
- Add explicit migration notes in SDK changelog for callback signature change.
- Add an integration test in docs CI to run quickstarts smoke test (basic compile/run).

End of scratchpad.
